multipleRoadmaps.question: Can I create more than one roadmap?
multipleRoadmaps.answer: The current Free plan supports one active roadmap at a time. Multiple roadmaps are planned for a future paid plan.

whenMultipleRoadmaps.question: When will multiple roadmaps be available?
whenMultipleRoadmaps.answer: Multiple roadmaps are planned for the upcoming Pro plan and will be available when the plan launches.

communityAvailable.question: Can I join the community?
communityAvailable.answer: Not yet. Community features aren't available in the current Free plan, but they're planned for Pro.

moreAiModels.question: Will AI Mentor support more AI models?
moreAiModels.answer: Yes. Support for multiple AI models is planned for future paid plans, giving you more flexibility in how your roadmap and feedback are generated.

hero.title: Your Personalized Learning Roadmap, Built by AI
hero.description: Tell AI Mentor what you want to learn, where you are today, and where you want to go. Get a personalized roadmap that guides you step by step toward your goal.

howItWork.title: A Learning Path That Adapts With You
howItWork.subtitle: Start with your goals, learn at your own pace, and get a roadmap that evolves as you make progress.

step1.title: Tell Us About Your Goals
step1.description: Share what you want to learn, your current experience, and how much time you have each week. AI Mentor uses these details to understand exactly where you're starting from, so every step that follows is built around your reality — not a generic average.

step2.title: Get Your Personalized Roadmap
step2.description: AI Mentor turns your goals and experience into a clear learning path with practical steps and milestones.

step3.title: Learn by Doing
step3.description: Practice what you learn with hands-on exercises and projects that help you build real skills, not just memorize information.

step4.title: Keep Moving Forward
step4.description: As you learn, your path adapts to your progress — spending less time on what you've already mastered and more on what still needs work. You'll always know exactly what to focus on next.
